chapter_seo_title: Dao Twisted World Ch 243: Li Huowang Breaks the Talisman Trap in Brutal Cave Ambush
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang’s group escapes the caves beneath Qingqiu, but Han Fu has been waiting in the dark—his talismans wrapped around Li Huowang’s organs. A short, brutal battle ends with the Heart-Element refusing to stay bound.
og_title: Chapter 243 — Talisman: A Clash of Will and Rotting Scripture
og_description: Li Huowang holds the rear while Bai Lingmiao slithers up the cave wall like a possessed snake. Han Fu thinks he’s won with his body-sealing talismans—until Li Huowang simply ignores them and carves him open.
twitter_description: Li Huowang’s talisman trap fails in the worst way. Han Fu’s two-headed debate ends in a bloody, vertical sword-stroke.

lore_anchors.definition: A Daoist ritual object—paper or drawn sigil—used to summon spirits, seal enemies, or ward off evil. In the Dao-Twisted World, they can be planted inside a victim’s body to immobilize them from within.
Li Huowang’s Daoist name in the Qingfeng Temple sect, meaning “Mysterious Yang.” Han Fu uses it mockingly to address him.
A massive talisman drawn on the ground, typically used to create a binding formation. Han Fu’s version is black-and-yellow and matches the color of his rotting teeth.
